data.name: Carbofex Oy
data.description: Carbofex Oy is a Finnish biochar producer based in Nokia that operates a continuous pyrolysis plant converting PEFC-certified spruce wood chips into high-carbon biochar while generating renewable heat for district energy. The company was the first registered commercial CORC trader on Puro.earth in 2019 and supplies biochar for agriculture, soil amendment, and water filtration globally.
